problems.PERMISSION_DENIED: Location access is blocked. Allow location for this site in your browser settings, then try again. You can also continue without a location; it may be refused or sent for review.
problems.UNAVAILABLE: Your device could not determine its location. Check that location services are on, then try again.
problems.TIMEOUT: Reading your location took too long. Try again, ideally near a window or outdoors.
problems.UNSUPPORTED: This browser cannot share a location. Use a current browser, or continue without a location.
problems.INSECURE: Location is only available over a secure (HTTPS) connection. Open the site over HTTPS, or continue without a location.
problems.STALE: Your device returned an old location. Try again to get a fresh one.

attendance.safeToRetry: It is safe to try again: if the first attempt was recorded, it will not be recorded twice.
attendance.privacyNotice: Your location is read once, only when you tap Check in or Check out, and compared with your work locations on the server. It is not tracked in the background. Location checks can be wrong; flagged check-ins are reviewed by a person.
attendance.privacyNoticeNoLocation: No location is needed today. Your check-in time is recorded by the server.
attendance.correctionHint: Your request is sent for approval. The original check-in and check-out stay on record.
attendance.checkOutNextDay: The check-out was on the next day (overnight shift)
attendance.correctionsEmpty: You have not requested any corrections.
attendance.adminCorrectHint: A direct correction is added to the record as a new entry; the original evidence stays. It is audited and needs a recent MFA confirmation.
attendance.evidenceHint: Entries are never edited or removed; corrections are added as new entries. Coordinates are never shown.

attendanceAdmin.lowAccuracyActionHint: Flagged check-ins are recorded and reviewed by a manager.
